description: Returns supermarket locations (Bónus, Krónan, Hagkaup, Nettó, Krambúðin, Costco) and regular hours from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0), combined with Icelandic statutory holiday checks via get_public_holidays rules.

chain.description: Optional supermarket chain filter (e.g. Bónus, Krónan, Hagkaup, Nettó).

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date to check holiday impact (defaults to today in Reykjavík).

name: get_shop_hours
title: Get Icelandic Supermarket Locations & Holiday Hours Impact
